context_requirements: Functional soluble guanylate cyclase (GUCY1A1/GUCY1B1) with intact heme for NO-independent activation
Vascular/smooth-muscle or platelet-like lineage for canonical sGC signalling
GABBR1 expression if the annotated target mediates any effect
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in cGMP-responsive landmark genes (e.g., PDE5A, ACTA2, MYH11) at 6 h
Consistent upregulation of NOS3, GUCY1A1 or cGMP-pathway genes across multiple lines
Shared transcriptional signature across the nine lines at 10 µM that is absent in vehicle controls

evidence.supports: sGC activator cinaciguat improves cardiac function in diabetic cardiomyopathy, indicating sGC/cGMP pathway engagement in vivo
sGC activator BAY 58-2667 reduces IL-6 and apoptosis in endotoxic shock, showing anti-inflammatory and anti-apoptotic effects of sGC activation
YC-1 potentiates apoptosis in ovarian carcinoma cells via death receptor and mitochondrial pathways
YC-1 enhances TRAIL-induced apoptosis in ovarian carcinoma cells
YC-1 enhances camptothecin-induced apoptosis in ovarian carcinoma cells
